errors.confirm: Tick the confirmation to send the announcement.
errors.date: Enter a valid date and time.

announcements.subtitle: Alerts sent to every member, to a group or to named members.
announcements.heading: Alerts sent
announcements.emptyDescription: Nothing has been sent to the members.

notices.sent: Alert sent. It is delivered in the background.

announcements.newSubtitle: Write a message for the members you choose.

form.heading: Alert
form.description: Members see the title and the start of the text in their notifications.
form.title: Title
form.urlHelp: Optional. A path on this site (starting with /) or an http(s) address that the alert opens. Without one it opens the notifications list.
form.audienceHelp: The sender gets the alert too when they are in the audience.
form.usernamesHelp: Used for named members. Separate them with commas; an unknown name stops the alert.
form.confirmWarning: This notifies everyone in the audience. It is delivered in the background and cannot be recalled or edited.
form.confirmBox: I understand it goes to the audience I chose

notifications.subtitle: What members get for each kind of notification until they choose otherwise.
notifications.heading: Defaults by type
notifications.description: New members start with these. Members who already chose keep their own choice.
notifications.help: A fixed type is always delivered and cannot be changed. A dash means the type does not use that channel.
notifications.followsWatch: Email respects each member's follow setting.

retention.label: Keep read notifications
retention.heading: Read notifications
retention.help: Read notifications older than this are deleted.

email.subtitle: How much mail the forum sends and what it contains.
email.heading: Email
email.description: Applies to notification and digest emails. Security emails are never capped.

mail.label: Mail
mail.offHelp: The forum cannot send email, so none of these settings has an effect yet.

emailHourlyCap.label: Notification emails per hour
emailHourlyCap.help: The most notification emails one member gets in an hour.

conversationEmailIncludesBody.label: Direct message emails
conversationEmailIncludesBody.help: When off, an email about a direct message only says there is one.
conversationEmailIncludesBody.switch: Include the text of the message

digestInactiveDays.label: Weekly digest
digestInactiveDays.help: The digest goes to members who have not visited for at least this long.

notices.subtitle: Banners shown under the header of every page.

list.heading: Notices
list.description: Newest first. Dates are in UTC.

create.heading: New notice
create.description: It is shown at once if it is active and inside its dates.

fields.title: Title
fields.dateHelp: Optional. Date and time in UTC; without a start it is shown at once.

noticeEdit.heading: Notice
noticeEdit.subtitle: Change what the notice says and who sees it.

notices.saved: Notice saved. Members who dismissed it do not see it again.

delete.heading: Delete the notice
delete.warning: The notice and the record of who dismissed it are deleted.
